pages.title: Metamaterial Cloaking Glass
pages.text: A pane of metamaterial that bends light around itself, so the glass is nearly invisible from any angle. Only the edges betray it, as a faint distortion in the room. Walking past it, the room behind seems to shift a little too smoothly, like a painted backdrop.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Metamaterials can steer light around an object. I built them into glass to see if I could make a window that vanished, and it nearly did.
